scope: New recovery-R1 loader foundation candidate from durable PR40 head386a3d182bf3e5e6229fc7b4826185fa2ad39e6f. This is not restoration of unavailable bytes or receipts.

finite_cases.case: One invented temporary toolcache, literal executable and library bytes, two literal proc-map segments and mocked process executable produce a complete identity. The executable pin is patched only inside this inert test. Recheck exact path, hash, size, device, inode and permitted loader environment.
Fixed rejection variants: relative toolcache, toolcache containing dot-dot, wrong executable location, symlink library, symlink library directory, missing library and non-regular library directory.

A literal file hashes successfully; synchronous mocked reads then mutate same-length bytes or replace the path during a read. Both changes must fail stable identity verification, with no threads or subprocesses.

Nine fixed failures: absent libpython mapping, alias path, deleted path, wrong device, wrong inode, additional other-version libpython, malformed proc-map line, same-inode differently named alias and a changed map between the two reads.
Seven fixed failures: LD_PRELOAD, LD_AUDIT, LD_DEBUG, LD_UNKNOWN, missing LD_LIBRARY_PATH, colon-separated LD_LIBRARY_PATH and wrong LD_LIBRARY_PATH.

A full identity and its exact five-field portable pin normalize identically. Nine literal malformed pins reject: missing field, extra field, wrong schema, boolean size, zero size, negative size, malformed library hash, wrong executable hash and wrong relative library path.

Ten fixed malformed full identities reject: extra field, missing field, noncanonical cache, wrong executable path, wrong library path, wrong directory, mismatched mapped path, device mismatch, inode mismatch and unexpected loader environment.

No loader strips every LD/PYTHON prefix; matching full identity and matching portable pin each restore only the verified directory. Mismatched full identity, mismatched pin, arbitrary path and unverified local identity each reject. Input dictionaries remain unchanged.
Mock only runtime prerequisites and the loader verifier. Verify runtime records full loader identity, propagates loader-verification failure and still rejects an extra PYTHON variable.

Read shell helper as inert text. Verify callable and exported contract, pinned executable SHA, exact toolcache-derived library, all-LD/PYTHON sanitation before external probes, non-symlink checks and failure guards. Verify absence of Python execution, eval, installation, global configuration and credential operations.

preserved_boundaries: Do not alter protocol, executable/version pin, historical source closure, science, RNG/deck semantics or any cap. Do not guess the actual runner library hash. No actual runner process, evaluator or fixture execution is authorized by this plan.
test_execution: Implementation worker writes this prospective finite plan and owned files only. The parent coordinates the fixed combined suite and retains every fresh run outcome. No unavailable historical receipt is recreated.
